notes: TWO independent web gating systems exist. (A) CANONICAL, plan-free: server projects a capability boolean map in services/api/src/services/platform-context/capability-registry.ts:67 (resolveCapabilities) built from scope+role+isPlatformAdmin (NOT raw plan); the web consumes envelope.capabilities via apps/web/lib/navigation/routeAccessResolver.ts:127 + apps/web/components/navigation/PageRouteGate.tsx. This path makes zero raw plan decisions. (B) PARALLEL, plan-based: apps/web/lib/surface/tiers.ts + access.ts map the raw plan string (from the server envelope) to a CORE/PROFESSIONAL/ENTERPRISE/INTERNAL tier CLIENT-SIDE, consumed by apps/web/middleware.ts, apps/web/components/surface/SurfaceGate.tsx, and the sidebar. System (B) is where the 'zero raw plan decisions' rule is violated.

Capability keys (CASES_VIEW, REPORTS_VIEW, EVIDENCE_CAPTURE, INTAKE_LINKS_MANAGE, etc.) are granted by scope+role and are plan-independent (capability-registry.ts:117-179). Commercial plan flags (casesIncluded, reportsIncluded, intakeIncluded) live in PLAN_CAPABILITIES and are projected to the envelope as planFeatures (platform-context.service.ts:454); only intakeIncluded is currently wired to a visibility gate (tiers.ts:148 entitlementOverride). casesIncluded/reportsIncluded are NOT wired to page visibility, so /cases and /reports load for FREE/PAYG via both gates even though the plan flag is false — feature-level enforcement (report generation, case creation) is server-side elsewhere.

ORGANIZATION_ONLY routes require envelope.activeSpace.type === 'ORGANIZATION' (routeAccessResolver.ts:168). A PERSONAL PRO/TEAM user is always in PERSONAL space, so these routes resolve NEEDS_ORGANIZATION regardless of plan; only an ENTERPRISE org workspace enables them. The surface-tier layer additionally marks most of them ENTERPRISE (notFound) for non-enterprise.
isEnterpriseWorkspace flag = plan is ENTERPRISE only (platform-context.service.ts:78 ENTERPRISE_PLAN_KEYS = {ENTERPRISE}); TEAM is NOT enterprise.
